quoted_text: The PEWEE 1 also set a record for the highest peak equivalent ideal vacuum specific impulse, 901 seconds.
note: IDEAL VACUUM specific impulse - a CALCULATED quantity, not a delivered measurement. The source defines the method: 'assumes an infinite nozzle expansion ratio, without losses, discharging into a perfect vacuum' and is 'based on the temperature of the hydrogen gas exiting the fuel elements NOT the nozzle chamber temperature'. Formula Isp = 12.8*sqrt(Te), Te in degrees R. Verified internally consistent: 2539 K = 4570 R -> 865.1; 2750 K = 4950 R -> 900.6. NOT directly comparable to the delivered Isp of a flight engine - see docs/data-collection.md. Range spans run-average (865) to peak (901).
